index_type.description: Exact type (accents optional), validated against: Personnes | Lieux | Organisations | Événements | Sujets | Notices d'autorité. An unrecognised value returns an error listing the valid types.

keyword.description: Every word must occur in the entry title (any order); "quote" a phrase, or give a whole alternate title
